privacy.s1.p: ft_transcendence is a multiplayer Pong platform built by students as a school project at 42. This policy explains which personal data the application handles and why.
privacy.s2.p: Email address, username, optional display name, bio and avatar, preferred language, a salted bcrypt hash of your password (never the password itself), your friends list, online status, match history, statistics, achievements and tournament participation.
privacy.s3.p: Only to run the service: authenticate you, show your profile, connect you with friends and opponents, run matchmaking and tournaments, and compute rankings. We do not use your data for advertising or profiling.
privacy.s4.p: Your username, display name, bio, avatar, online status, level, ELO and match results are visible to other users. Your email address is never shown to other users.
privacy.s5.p: Data is stored in a PostgreSQL database and avatars on the server file system. Passwords are hashed and salted, and all browser-to-server traffic uses HTTPS. No data is sold or shared with third parties.
privacy.s6.p: We use no tracking or advertising cookies. Your browser local storage only keeps your session token and your language choice so the site works as expected.
privacy.s7.p: You can view and edit your profile at any time from the Profile page. Under the GDPR you may also ask for access, correction or deletion of your data by contacting the project team through the 42 school.
terms.s1.p: By creating an account or using ft_transcendence you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.s2.p: You are responsible for the activity on your account and for keeping your password confidential. Provide accurate information and do not impersonate other people.
terms.s3.p: Play fair: no cheating, exploiting bugs, automation or disrupting matches. Harassment, hate speech and abusive usernames, bios or avatars are forbidden.
terms.s4.p: You keep ownership of the content you provide (avatar, bio, display name) and grant us the right to display it inside the service. You must have the right to share it and it must be lawful.
terms.s5.p: We may restrict or remove accounts and content that break these terms or the law, with or without prior notice.
terms.s6.p: This is an educational project provided "as is", without warranty. It may be unavailable, changed or reset at any time, and match data may be lost. To the extent permitted by law, the team is not liable for damages resulting from its use.
terms.s7.p: We may update these terms; continued use means you accept the new version. These terms are governed by French law.
